title: Synthetic-user startup Simile raises $200M at $2B valuation 5 months after $100M Series A
summary: Just five months after emerging from stealth and announcing a $100 million Series A led by Index Ventures, it has closed a $200 million Series B at a $2 billion valuation, the startup says .
